title: A wrapped prompt row starts with the space it broke at
body:
`prompt::wrap_rows` breaks the prompt into rows at word breaks. When a word does not fit, the space before it goes to the start of the next row rather than the end of the row above. A 40-column prompt holding `... twelve thirteen fourteen` drew its last row as ` fourteen`, one column in from the others.

## Proposal

The space a row breaks at stays at the end of the row above, as in agent text. The cursor and Up and Down (`prompt::row_above`, `prompt::row_below`) use the same rows, so their tests in `prompt.rs` need checking.
